uploadDialogIntro: The agent wants to upload a workspace asset to an external URL
uploadDialogTargetLabel: Target URL (editable; use wildcards when saving to a list, path is ignored)
uploadDialogHint: e.g. https://*.example.com matches example.com and all its subdomains
settingsLogDesc: Records the args, gating verdicts, user decisions and network results of every download_asset / upload_asset call (secret plaintext auto-redacted) to help locate agent issues. The most recent entries persist with the plugin data and can be exported as .txt; clearing cannot be undone.
